body.p: Claim 1 is cancelled. Consequently, the rejections of record are moot.

New claims 2-52 are presented. The new claims include the substantive limitations of the allowed claims in the parent application, which is now U.S. Patent 11,511,737 (the '737 patent). In particular, new claims 2-31 correspond to claims 1-30 in the '737 patent. New claims 32-38 correspond to claims 3 1-37 in the '737 patent. New claims 39-45 correspond to claims 38-44 in the '737 patent. New claims 46-52 correspond to claims 45-5 1 in the '737 patent.
Applicant submits a Terminal Disclaimer to obviate any double patenting rejection.
Accordingly, all claims should be in a condition for allowance. If there are any residual issues that can be resolved with a telephone call, the Examiner is requested to contact the undersigned.
The Director is hereby authorized to charge any appropriate fees under 37 C.F.R. @@§1.16,
1.17, and 1.21 that may be required by this paper, and to credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 50-1283 referencing Docket No. SYSM-001/02US 337597-2006.
